Subject: 5 stars — they caught my drawing mistake and still delivered early

Arroyo Precision Works made a camera-to-dewar adapter plate and an internally threaded light baffle for our near-IR camera (PO 26-41187). Both parts were 6061-T6 with black anodizing. We needed them for our Palomar run starting November 18, so the schedule mattered, but what impressed me most was the care they took before cutting anything.

The bolt-circle problem was my mistake. On sheet 2, I had copied a dimension from an older drawing and left the bolt circle as 4.125 on an otherwise millimeter-dimensioned drawing. It should have been 4.125 inches, or 104.8 mm, not 4.125 mm. Tiff caught the inconsistency during setup, and Ruben contacted me to confirm it before machining. If they had simply followed the drawing, the screws would have landed inside the bore. That one question probably saved us a scrapped plate and a serious delay. I am very grateful that they actually read and thought about the drawing instead of just running the job.

The finished parts were excellent. At our November 9 fit test, the plate mounted onto the dewar with all eight screws going in without any forcing. Flatness across the face measured less than 0.01 mm on the dial indicator. The baffle threads ran smoothly, and a 300-second dark frame with the lab lights on looked the same as the closed-dewar test, with no detectable light leak. The anodizing was also even, with no bare spots.

Delivery was much faster than expected. A large vendor had quoted us about six weeks for the work. Arroyo quoted 21 days and delivered only nine days after the PO, including the black anodizing. Ruben sent the inspection sheet, then drove the parts to Robinson himself on his way to another supplier, with no delivery charge. After weeks of worrying about whether we would make the observing run, I was relieved enough that I nearly hugged him.

For other labs, especially anyone making one-off instrument parts, I would strongly recommend them. They communicate clearly, pay attention to details that are easy to miss, and still meet an aggressive schedule. Nothing about the job felt rushed despite the fast turnaround.

I also hope purchasing will add Arroyo to the preferred-vendor list. This order showed exactly the combination we need for research equipment: careful review before machining, good inspection and finish, parts that fit the first time, and genuine effort to get them to us when promised. Five stars without hesitation.
